name: Banseiki pool hotseat bridge: random leaders for two humans and two AI, growth and saved person records

steps.code:
local id=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local p=Players[id]
if not GameConfiguration.IsHotseat() or not p or not p:IsHuman() or not p:IsTurnActive() then error('active human hotseat turn required') end
if id ~= 0 or Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() ~= GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 0 then error('unexpected hotseat player or round') end
return tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())..'|'..tostring(id)

if not GameConfiguration.IsHotseat() then error('hotseat required') end
if not Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_INITIALIZED') then error('growth not initialized') end
local current=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); local active=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local baseline=JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS
local nextGrowth={}; local rows={tostring(current),tostring(active)}
for pid=0,1 do
  local p=Players[pid]
  if not p or not p:IsHuman() then error('two human players required') end
  local units={}; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do table.insert(units,u) end
  table.sort(units,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
  local count=0
  for _,u in ipairs(units) do
    local r=u:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_WARLORD')
    if r then
      count=count+1
      if type(r.Level)~='number' or r.Level<1 or r.Level>30 or r.Level~=math.floor(r.Level) or type(r.XP)~='number' or r.XP<0 or r.XP~=math.floor(r.XP) then error('invalid growth numbers') end
      if type(r.Equipment)~='table' then error('invalid growth equipment') end
      local last=r.LastXPTurn
      if last~=nil and (type(last)~='number' or last~=math.floor(last)) then error('invalid growth turn') end
      local total=r.XP
      for level=1,r.Level-1 do total=total+math.floor(30*level^1.5+0.5) end
      local key=tostring(pid)..':'..tostring(u:GetID())
      if nextGrowth[key] then error('duplicate growth unit '..key) end
      local previous=baseline and baseline[key]
      if baseline and not previous then error('unexpected growth unit '..key) end
      if previous then
        local metadataChanged=r.Personality~=previous.personality or r.Trait~=previous.trait or r.Artifact~=previous.artifact or #r.Equipment~=#previous.equipment
        if not metadataChanged then
          for i=1,#r.Equipment do if r.Equipment[i]~=previous.equipment[i] then metadataChanged=true; break end end
        end
        if metadataChanged then
          if pid==active then error('active growth metadata changed for '..key) end
          error('inactive growth record changed for '..key)
        end
        if pid==active then
          local increment=previous.last==current and 0 or 20
          if total~=previous.total+increment then error('growth did not advance once for '..key) end
          if last~=current then error('active player growth was not credited for '..key) end
        elseif r.Level~=previous.level or r.XP~=previous.xp or last~=previous.last then
          error('inactive growth record changed for '..key)
        end
      end
      local equipment={}; for i=1,#r.Equipment do equipment[i]=r.Equipment[i] end
      nextGrowth[key]={total=total,last=last,level=r.Level,xp=r.XP,personality=r.Personality,trait=r.Trait,equipment=equipment,artifact=r.Artifact}
      table.insert(rows,table.concat({pid,u:GetID(),r.Level,r.XP,r.Personality,r.Trait,table.concat(r.Equipment,','),r.Artifact or 'none',r.LastXPTurn or -1},'~'))
    end
  end
  if count~=2 then error('expected 2 growth records for player '..pid..', got '..count) end
end
if baseline then for key,_ in pairs(baseline) do if not nextGrowth[key] then error('missing growth unit '..key) end end end
JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS=nextGrowth
local growth=table.concat(rows,'|')
local poolRows,poolByLeader=0,{}
for row in GameInfo.JAC_BanseikiPool() do poolRows=poolRows+1; poolByLeader[row.LeaderType]=row end
local ledgerRows,ledgerVersion,ledgerCount=0,nil,nil
for row in GameInfo.JAC_BanseikiPoolLedger() do ledgerRows=ledgerRows+1; ledgerVersion=row.Version; ledgerCount=row.Count end
if poolRows~=300 or ledgerRows~=1 or ledgerCount~=300 or type(ledgerVersion)~='string' or not ledgerVersion:match('^300:%x+$') then error('pool ledger '..poolRows..' '..ledgerRows..' '..tostring(ledgerCount)..' '..tostring(ledgerVersion)) end
local savedLedger=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BANSEIKI_POOL_LEDGER')
if savedLedger~=ledgerVersion then error('saved pool ledger '..tostring(savedLedger)) end
local poolParts={savedLedger}
local function poolPerson(pid,leader)
  local row=poolByLeader[leader]; local p=Players[pid]; local c=PlayerConfigurations[pid]
  if not row or not p or not c or not p:IsHuman() then error('pool human '..pid..' '..tostring(leader)) end
  if c:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=row.CivilizationType then error('pool civilization '..pid..' '..tostring(c:GetCivilizationTypeName())) end
  local person=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_PERSON_ID')
  local trait=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_TRAIT')
  local role=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_ROLE')
  if person~=row.PersonID or trait~=row.TraitType or role~='LEADER' then error('pool person '..pid..' '..tostring(person)..' '..tostring(trait)..' '..tostring(role)) end
  return table.concat({pid,leader,row.CivilizationType,person,trait,role},'~')
end
local poolMajors=0
for _ in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do poolMajors=poolMajors+1 end
if poolMajors~=4 then error('random pool majors '..poolMajors) end
local poolLeaders={}
for pid=0,3 do
  local c=PlayerConfigurations[pid]; local p=Players[pid]
  local leader=c and c:GetLeaderTypeName()
  if not p or type(leader)~='string' or leader=='RANDOM' or not GameInfo.Leaders[leader] or p:IsHuman()~=(pid<2) then error('random pool player '..pid..' '..tostring(leader)) end
  if poolLeaders[leader] then error('random pool duplicate leader '..leader) end
  poolLeaders[leader]=true
  if pid<2 then poolParts[#poolParts+1]=poolPerson(pid,leader)
  else poolParts[#poolParts+1]=table.concat({pid,leader,tostring(c:GetCivilizationTypeName())},'~') end
end
return growth..'|JAC_POOL|'..table.concat(poolParts,';')

if not GameConfiguration.IsHotseat() then error('hotseat required') end
if not Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_INITIALIZED') then error('growth not initialized') end
local current=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); local active=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local baseline=JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS
local nextGrowth={}; local rows={tostring(current),tostring(active)}
for pid=0,1 do
  local p=Players[pid]
  if not p or not p:IsHuman() then error('two human players required') end
  local units={}; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do table.insert(units,u) end
  table.sort(units,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
  local count=0
  for _,u in ipairs(units) do
    local r=u:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_WARLORD')
    if r then
      count=count+1
      if type(r.Level)~='number' or r.Level<1 or r.Level>30 or r.Level~=math.floor(r.Level) or type(r.XP)~='number' or r.XP<0 or r.XP~=math.floor(r.XP) then error('invalid growth numbers') end
      if type(r.Equipment)~='table' then error('invalid growth equipment') end
      local last=r.LastXPTurn
      if last~=nil and (type(last)~='number' or last~=math.floor(last)) then error('invalid growth turn') end
      local total=r.XP
      for level=1,r.Level-1 do total=total+math.floor(30*level^1.5+0.5) end
      local key=tostring(pid)..':'..tostring(u:GetID())
      if nextGrowth[key] then error('duplicate growth unit '..key) end
      local previous=baseline and baseline[key]
      if baseline and not previous then error('unexpected growth unit '..key) end
      if previous then
        local metadataChanged=r.Personality~=previous.personality or r.Trait~=previous.trait or r.Artifact~=previous.artifact or #r.Equipment~=#previous.equipment
        if not metadataChanged then
          for i=1,#r.Equipment do if r.Equipment[i]~=previous.equipment[i] then metadataChanged=true; break end end
        end
        if metadataChanged then
          if pid==active then error('active growth metadata changed for '..key) end
          error('inactive growth record changed for '..key)
        end
        if pid==active then
          local increment=previous.last==current and 0 or 20
          if total~=previous.total+increment then error('growth did not advance once for '..key) end
          if last~=current then error('active player growth was not credited for '..key) end
        elseif r.Level~=previous.level or r.XP~=previous.xp or last~=previous.last then
          error('inactive growth record changed for '..key)
        end
      end
      local equipment={}; for i=1,#r.Equipment do equipment[i]=r.Equipment[i] end
      nextGrowth[key]={total=total,last=last,level=r.Level,xp=r.XP,personality=r.Personality,trait=r.Trait,equipment=equipment,artifact=r.Artifact}
      table.insert(rows,table.concat({pid,u:GetID(),r.Level,r.XP,r.Personality,r.Trait,table.concat(r.Equipment,','),r.Artifact or 'none',r.LastXPTurn or -1},'~'))
    end
  end
  if count~=2 then error('expected 2 growth records for player '..pid..', got '..count) end
end
if baseline then for key,_ in pairs(baseline) do if not nextGrowth[key] then error('missing growth unit '..key) end end end
JAC_HOTSEAT_GROWTH_PREVIOUS=nextGrowth
local growth=table.concat(rows,'|')
local poolRows,poolByLeader=0,{}
for row in GameInfo.JAC_BanseikiPool() do poolRows=poolRows+1; poolByLeader[row.LeaderType]=row end
local ledgerRows,ledgerVersion,ledgerCount=0,nil,nil
for row in GameInfo.JAC_BanseikiPoolLedger() do ledgerRows=ledgerRows+1; ledgerVersion=row.Version; ledgerCount=row.Count end
if poolRows~=300 or ledgerRows~=1 or ledgerCount~=300 or type(ledgerVersion)~='string' or not ledgerVersion:match('^300:%x+$') then error('pool ledger '..poolRows..' '..ledgerRows..' '..tostring(ledgerCount)..' '..tostring(ledgerVersion)) end
local savedLedger=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BANSEIKI_POOL_LEDGER')
if savedLedger~=ledgerVersion then error('saved pool ledger '..tostring(savedLedger)) end
local poolParts={savedLedger}
local function poolPerson(pid,leader)
  local row=poolByLeader[leader]; local p=Players[pid]; local c=PlayerConfigurations[pid]
  if not row or not p or not c or not p:IsHuman() then error('pool human '..pid..' '..tostring(leader)) end
  if c:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=row.CivilizationType then error('pool civilization '..pid..' '..tostring(c:GetCivilizationTypeName())) end
  local person=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_PERSON_ID')
  local trait=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_TRAIT')
  local role=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_ROLE')
  if person~=row.PersonID or trait~=row.TraitType or role~='LEADER' then error('pool person '..pid..' '..tostring(person)..' '..tostring(trait)..' '..tostring(role)) end
  return table.concat({pid,leader,row.CivilizationType,person,trait,role},'~')
end
local poolMajors=0
for _ in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do poolMajors=poolMajors+1 end
if poolMajors~=4 then error('random pool majors '..poolMajors) end
local poolLeaders={}
for pid=0,3 do
  local c=PlayerConfigurations[pid]; local p=Players[pid]
  local leader=c and c:GetLeaderTypeName()
  if not p or type(leader)~='string' or leader=='RANDOM' or not GameInfo.Leaders[leader] or p:IsHuman()~=(pid<2) then error('random pool player '..pid..' '..tostring(leader)) end
  if poolLeaders[leader] then error('random pool duplicate leader '..leader) end
  poolLeaders[leader]=true
  if pid<2 then poolParts[#poolParts+1]=poolPerson(pid,leader)
  else poolParts[#poolParts+1]=table.concat({pid,leader,tostring(c:GetCivilizationTypeName())},'~') end
end
return growth..'|JAC_POOL|'..table.concat(poolParts,';')
